newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end sharply lower, off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end sharply lower, off lows.

text.p: Jan 10 - U.S. debt futures ended pit trading sharply lower, off day's lows. Traders fretted about possible Fed rate hike to slow growth, raise jobless rate. Some said back-month Euros have priced in 25 bp rate hike, March nearly has. They said afternon action dwindled. Long end concerned about corporate supplies, technicians differ over price recovery prospects. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
In the short end, traders said the back months had priced in a quarter-point Fed tightening, with some saying the market still was weighing a potential 25-basis-point hike during the first quarter.

At settlement, March T-bonds fell 1-02/32 to 110-11/32, T-notes lost 22/32 to 107-30/32, muni-bonds fell 25/32 to 114-10/32, T-bills fell five bps to 94.88, and March Eurodollars dropped five bps to 94.34. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
